comparison.description: Identifies this comparison record; matches its file name (WI011-AC07's own naming discipline for protected inputs).

limitations.description: What this comparison record does not prove, stated by the record itself rather than left for a reader to discover (WI011-AC03). Required and non-empty: every comparison record carries at least the field-path keying limitation, since a record keyed by field path cannot notice that the text inside an already-classified field was reworded.

differences.description: Every field of the protected adapter schema on which the protected adapter declarations do not all agree, keyed by its dotted field path (WI011-AC03: keyed by field path, not by the differing values themselves, so a reworded rationale does not reopen an already-classified field). The evaluator recomputes this set at check time: a real difference missing here fails as unclassified, and a key here naming a field the declarations no longer disagree on fails as stale.

classification.description: genuine_defect: the difference passes all three clauses of WI011-AC01's rule, so it is a Core abstraction weakness. expected_difference: the difference fails at least one clause, so Core is not corrected for it.

clause.description: Required, and only meaningful, for expected_difference: names the WI011-AC01 clause this difference fails. fails_clause_a: the difference is in the fact the two adapters have, not in how Core represents it — changing Core's representation would not make it disappear. fails_clause_b: no Core control is weaker or unmeasurable because of this difference — every control already handles it correctly. fails_clause_c: correcting it would need a provider or model name in Core, or new evidence from a live adapter session.

correction.description: Required, and only meaningful, for genuine_defect: whether this work item corrected it or is deferring the correction.

rationale.description: Why this classification and, if applicable, this clause — citing the repository fact that decided it, not asserted from taste.

status.description: deferred: the objective's own restraint clause — the correction would need a third adapter, MA-01 delegation machinery, an untrusted-external-content boundary, a route or routing-policy change, or new evidence from a live adapter session, none of which this work item builds. A deferred defect is never reclassified as expected_difference to avoid the work.

reason.description: Required when status is deferred: names which of those the correction would need.
